001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy.operation;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy.EconomyCore;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.operation.Operation;
006import org.bukkit.World;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
008import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
009
010/**
011 * Operation about deposit money.
012 */
013public class DepositEconomyOperation implements Operation {
014
015  private final QUser account;
016  private final double amount;
017  private final EconomyCore economyCore;
018  private final World world;
019  private final String currency;
020  private boolean committed = false;
021  private boolean rollback = false;
022
023  public DepositEconomyOperation(@NotNull final QUser account, final double amount, @NotNull final World world, @Nullable final String currency, @NotNull final EconomyCore economyCore) {
024
025    this.account = account;
026    this.amount = amount;
027    this.world = world;
028    this.currency = currency;
029    this.economyCore = economyCore;
030  }
031
032  @Override
033  public boolean commit() {
034
035    final boolean result = economyCore.deposit(account, amount, world, currency);
036    if(result) {
037      committed = true;
038    }
039    return result;
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public boolean isCommitted() {
044
045    return this.committed;
046  }
047
048  @Override
049  public boolean isRollback() {
050
051    return this.rollback;
052  }
053
054  @Override
055  public boolean rollback() {
056
057    final boolean result = economyCore.withdraw(account, amount, world, currency);
058    if(result) {
059      rollback = true;
060    }
061    return result;
062  }
063}
